name: nurse-prs
description: Drive a repo's open PRs (and related issues) to a landable state WITHOUT approving or merging: respond to review comments, validate changes end-to-end and post the results, keep every branch mergeable (resolve conflicts as siblings land), flip validated drafts to ready, triage related issues, keep a persistent monitor up for autonomous response to new activity, and surface merge/approve/design decisions to the human as crisp judgement asks.
